newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue chip shares end mixed, key index falls.
newsitem.headline: KL blue chip shares end mixed, key index falls.

text.p: UMW Holdings stock surged while AMMB fell further as blue chips showed a mixed performance, dealers said.
They said vehicle stock UMW was chased up by local funds after recent falls. Financial services group AMMB was depressed by views that interest rates will stay firm.
At the close, the key Composite Index of large-capitalised stocks fell 3.22 points to 1,066.74. The Second Board index of small-cap issues was down 3.46 to 565.74.
"Local funds were behind UMW. No, there's no news tied to it that I know," said a Malaysian brokerage dealer.
UMW jumped 1.0 ringgit in late afternoon trading to 12.50 on volume of 570,000 shares traded.
AMMB extended its 40-cent fall on Wednesday to end 50 cents lower at 15.50 on volume of 1.6 million, on lingering worries that still-firm domestic interest rates will crimp its earnings.
"Interest rates remain high and AMMB is big in property loans," said another dealer.
Problems with the Thai baht will encourage Malaysian authorities to keep local rates high to prevent speculative attacks on the ringgit, said ING-Barings banking analyst Soon Teck Onn.
